options.title: 披发 · 温柔日常
options.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a polished semi-realistic visual novel character sprite, a new fictional adult woman named 飘 (Piao). One single woman per image.
Input images: Images 1 and 2 are APPEARANCE references for Piao, combining the same woman's natural facial characteristics and black hair. They are reference photos, not images to reproduce literally. Image 3 is ONLY a rendering-style and framing reference from the existing game: emulate its detailed semi-realistic painted rendering, subtle fabric texture, natural anatomy and head-to-mid-thigh framing. Do NOT borrow the face, brown hair, outfit, camera, or accessories from image 3.
Subject: fictional Chinese woman in her mid-20s, unmistakably an adult. Maintain recognizable reference-informed facial traits: soft oval face with slightly full cheeks, small gently rounded chin instead of a sharp V jaw, natural straight fine brows, dark almond eyes of realistic size, delicate low-to-moderate nasal bridge with a softly rounded tip, small natural lips, black hair and light natural makeup. Let the two photo references define her features instead of generic glamorous doll beauty. Refine into a coherent fictional character, do not reproduce a photograph.
Style: premium semi-realistic hand-painted game portrait, very restrained visible paint texture, fine strands of hair, subtle skin texture, believable fabric and folds, grounded everyday Chinese contemporary setting.
Composition: vertical portrait around 1024 x 1536, centered, standing naturally, visible from the entire head to mid-thigh, clear padding above hair and around both elbows. Eye-level view, slight three-quarter torso and face turned toward viewer. Natural adult proportions, no wide-angle distortion.
Lighting: soft neutral daylight, gentle form shading. TRUE TRANSPARENT background, clean alpha silhouette including fine hair; no opaque backdrop, no simulated checkerboard, no dark smoke, no glow halo, no floor or scene.
Constraints: no phone, no selfie pose, no mirror, no UI/player controls, no camera, no text, no watermark, no other people, no school uniform, no exaggerated anime eyes, no plastic skin. Fully clothed casual adult character, anatomically sound hands. No plot, biography or additional props. The name 飘 is metadata, do not print it in the image.
Design option A — soft everyday long-haired look, primarily inspired by reference image 1.
Long loose black hair falling below the chest, naturally flowing with a little volume, loose off-center side-swept bangs framing the face. Preserve the soft cheeks and narrow natural eyes visible in reference 1, with the nose and mouth clarified by reference 2. A small relaxed closed-mouth smile, gentle direct gaze and a slight natural head tilt.
Outfit: loose charcoal-grey wool coat like the first reference, worn open over a plain dark fine-knit crewneck top, dark straight-cut jeans visible at the bottom. Ordinary tasteful muted everyday clothes with realistic wool texture.
Pose: relaxed standing, one hand lightly holding the coat lapel near the lower chest and the other resting naturally by the side near the coat pocket. Shoulders relaxed. The overall impression is warm, quiet and approachable.
